title: Extra Hammers
description: Powerful and well-designed hammers to improve mining in Minecraft
body:
![Extra Hammers Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6243c639c03766d64fe8ac2d0d63fef337f4b39.png)
## About

Tired of mining block by block in Minecraft? **Extra Hammers** is a mod designed to make mining faster, easier, and more satisfying. Say goodbye to repetitive digging and focus on enjoying your world!

**Extra Hammers** adds powerful hammers that work like pickaxes but break multiple blocks at once, making resource gathering and area clearing much faster. Each hammer corresponds to a vanilla material, ensuring balance and familiarity while improving efficiency.

Our main goal is simple: create a balanced, fun, and practical mod that focuses solely on hammers. No unnecessary extras, just tools that make mining a joy.

## Content

**⚠️ Mod currently in Testing Phase**

Hammers can be crafted using normal vanilla materials, from wood to netherite. No new rare materials or complicated recipes—just straightforward crafting.

### Hammer list:

**~ Wooden Hammer**  ![Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d00ee0b0d0440d157136462e0f5e363f1fd9de3.png)

**~ Stone Hammer**  ![Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e12f74fd20471d7f7585e61d35fdd063979b013.png)

**~ Iron Hammer**  ![Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8dc6a80726e4e422424e19d68597897cf9570053.png)

**~ Golden Hammer**  ![Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a464c1e8c923f2ea7b43c2fdfc5250b1badd7af9.png)

**~ Diamond Hammer**  ![Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3258637e005bc6d8d4c9c790ff2267e5ca3332e5.png)

**~ Netherite Hammer**  ![Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/784ffe0240eb49c026e954b7110427b59cffb402.png)

All hammers follow the progression of vanilla tools, making them easy to integrate into any survival or modded gameplay.

## Features

**~** Powerful but balanced hammers for every tier

**~** Vanilla-style textures for a seamless look

**~** Simple, easy-to-understand crafting

**~** Improves mining efficiency without changing game balance

## Translations 

Currently available in **English**, **German**, **French** and **Polish**!
_But Russian is coming soon too!_

## FAQ

**Q**: Does this mod work on my Minecraft version? 

**A**: Right now it should work only for the 1.21.1 Version of Java Minecraft.


**Q**: Will there be a backport to older versions? 

**A**: No, we focus on keeping the mod updated for the newest Minecraft releases.


**Q**: Can I use this in my modpack? 

**A**: Absolutely!


**Q**: How can I support your work?
